title: Integrative simulation analysis of myocardial ischaemia-reperfusion injury.
intervention: simulated strategies to mitigate cardiac reperfusion injury in an in silico model: preservation of mitochondrial NADH production, attenuation of ATP consumption (via SERCA or contraction), activation of the Na+/K+ pump (no pharmacological agent tested)

outcomes.name: cytosolic Na+/Ca2+ overload during reperfusion
outcomes.effect_text: preservation of mitochondrial NADH production ... mitigates reperfusion injury

outcomes.name: contraction failure
outcomes.effect_text: attenuation of ATP consumption via SERCA or contraction for a short period ... mitigates reperfusion injury
